    SELECT s.supplier_id, s.name, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
    FROM suppliers s
    JOIN products p ON s.supplier_id = p.supplier_id
    JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name
)
SELECT name, average_rating
FROM supplier_ratings
WHERE average_rating > 4.5;

results.question: For each order status, show the average number of items per order, counting item quantities rather than order-item rows.
results.initial_sql:
WITH order_item_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
),
status_totals AS (
    SELECT o.status, o.order_id, ot.total_quantity
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_item_totals ot ON ot.order_id = o.order_id
)
SELECT status, AVG(total_quantity) AS average_items_per_order
FROM status_totals
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status ASC
